# DaisyUI docs starter

Its files are in [`ext/pages/starters/daisyui-docs`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/pages/starters/daisyui-docs). See every [starter kit](https://pocketone.dev/docs/starters).

![The DaisyUI docs kit's splash page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/screenshots/starter-daisyui-docs.jpg)

![A docs page in the DaisyUI docs kit, with its sidebar](https://pocketone.dev/docs/screenshots/starter-daisyui-docs-page.jpg)

A docs site built from Markdown pages, styled with [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) and [DaisyUI](https://daisyui.com/). It shows layout groups (`(splash)` for the home page, `(main)` for the docs), nested layouts, and a Markdown partial (`docs/_private/toc.md`) as the table of contents. Add a page by dropping a `.md` file in `pb_pages/(main)/docs/`. The compiled `pb_pages/assets/app.css` is included; npm is only for rebuilding the CSS.

Templates are `.ets` (EJS whose tags hold TypeScript) and code files (`+config`, `+middleware`, and the `.ts` beside a page or serving an endpoint) are `.ts`; Pages strips the types when it loads them, so there is still no build step.

```bash
pocketone pages create myapp --starter daisyui-docs
cd myapp
pocketone superuser upsert you@example.com <password> --dir ./pb_data
pocketone serve --dir ./pb_data
```

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8090.

To change styles, rebuild the CSS while you edit:

```bash
npm i
npm run dev:css
```

## Files

```
pb_pages/
  +layout.ets
  (splash)/index.ets             the home page, in its own layout
  (main)/+layout.ets
  (main)/docs/+layout.ets        the docs layout, with the table of contents
  (main)/docs/_private/toc.md    the table of contents
  (main)/docs/overview.md        a docs page: add more beside it
```

Live demo: [pocketpages-daisyui-docs.pockethost.io](https://pocketpages-daisyui-docs.pockethost.io).
